what_i_changed: Made `migrate()` atomic using a SQLite savepoint and replaced `executescript()` with individual statement execution, preventing implicit commits during multi-step upgrades.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: Any migration failure rolls back all created schema objects and `user_version` changes before re-raising. Verified: normal suite 318 passed, 3 skipped; acceptance scenario and a later-statement failure scenario passed on Python 3.14.
